description: INPADOC family — every related patent publication worldwide covering the same underlying invention, which is how you find the Chinese, Japanese, US, European and PCT/WO members of one filing. Returns a member count and the countries covered first, then one row per family member: publication number (with kind and date), application number, and priority claims. A PCT international application is a normal member here — give its "WO" publication number, or (before it has published) a WIPO application number like "PCT/US2024/012345". This does NOT include the International Search Report or Written Opinion of a PCT application — EPO OPS does not carry that document at all; for it, go to WIPO PATENTSCOPE (patentscope.wipo.int). Give the publication number as printed on the document; a trailing kind code is handled for you.

number.description: Publication number as printed on the document, e.g. "EP1234567", "CN117928705A", "US10000000", or a PCT international publication like "WO2025028566" / "WO 2025/028566" / "WO2025028566A1". Spaces, commas and slashes are ignored, and a trailing kind code (the "A" / "A1" / "B1" suffix) is retried without it if the exact form is not indexed. A WIPO-style PCT application number is also accepted before it has published, e.g. "PCT/US2024/012345" — this is resolved to the receiving office's application record and the family it belongs to; if that application number is not yet indexed, the response says so and names the number it tried.

raw.description: Include the raw OPS XML-as-JSON family payload alongside the normalised member list. Off by default — the normalised list has everything most callers need.

name: get_family

outputSchema.description: INPADOC patent family — related applications worldwide
